articles.title: Kraken parent Payward seeks fresh funding at $20 billion valuation ahead of planned IPO
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator is pursuing a new fundraising round as it ramps up acquisitions across derivatives and stablecoins while laying the groundwork for a future public listing.

articles.title: Corpay taps BVNK to bring stablecoin wallets to corporate payments
articles.snippet: Corpay will use stablecoin rails in its treasury operations to improve capital efficiency, reduce reliance on pre-funded accounts, and move funds across its global footprint.

articles.title: The biggest consensus overhaul in Solana history is officially live for testing
articles.snippet: The upgrade, known as Alpenglow, is live on a community test cluster, said Solana core developer Anza.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: SUI surges 25% over weekend
articles.snippet: Cronos (CRO), up 9.7% from Friday, joined Sui (SUI) as a top performer.

articles.title: Bitcoin whipsaws on CME open as Iran tensions pressure crypto markets
articles.snippet: BTC briefly topped $82,400 before slipping below $81,000 as traders repositioned around CME futures open and geopolitical risks rattled markets.
